(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore carries a tight ISO fit tolerance of 0.018 mm, but the drawing does not account for the thickness added by the I.Z.B.P. plating; after coating the hole will be undersize and may reject a mating shaft. The designer should add a note specifying that the hole is to be machined undersize to allow for plating buildup, or that it must be masked during plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note such as '⌀16 H7 dimension applies after plating' or specify pre-plate machining limits to accommodate the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."}]}
